embeddings.title: Ukulungisa amaxwebhu akho
embeddings.description: Ukwenza isalathiso kwiifayile eziqhotyoshelweyo ukuze zikhangelwe kwaye zikhankanywe. Oku kungathatha umzuzwana kumaxwebhu amakhulu.

creation.musicLyricsGuide: Chaza isimbo nelizwi kwisicelo. Bhala amazwi engoma phantsi kwezi thegi zingezantsi. Cima {{instrumental}} ukuze kubekho ukucula.
creation.setupStorage: Zonke iifayile: {{download}}. Uvimba: {{reserve}}. Indawo eyongezelelweyo efunekayo: {{required}}. Indawo evulekileyo kwidiski ekhethiweyo: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Kusafuneka {{missing}}. Khulula indawo okanye ukhethe enye idiski enendawo eyaneleyo.
creation.setupTextNote: NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B Q4_K_M imodeli yesicatshulwa yendawo ecetyiswayo yencoko, ukubhala, ukufowuna kwesixhobo kunye neziphumo ezicwangcisiweyo. Umxholo wokuqala uthi 16K iimpawu; khangela imemori ekhoyo phambi kokuba uyandise. Igalelo lombhalo kunye nemveliso kuphela, ngaphandle kwemodeli eyidrafti. Sebenzisa uphendlo okanye amaxwebhu akho ukuqinisekisa amabango ayinyani.
creation.setupImageNote: Umfanekiso — FLUX.2 Klein 4B · Q4_K_M. Umbhalo: Qwen3 4B · Q4_K_M · CPU. VAE: FLUX.2. Aspect ratio: 21:9; Isisombululo: 1024 × 432; Amanyathelo okuvelisa: 4; Indlela yembewu: Ngokuzenzekelayo.
creation.setupMusicNote: Umculo — ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo. Umenzi womculo: 2B · Q4_K_M; Umcwangcisi womculo: 1.7B · Q8_0; Umbhalo: Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B · Q8_0; VAE: BF16. Ubude bomculo: 10–600 s; Umgangatho wesandi: 48 kHz · 2.0; Umculo wezixhobo / Amagama engoma; Ngokuzenzekelayo.
creation.setupVideoNote: Ividiyo — Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B · Q4_K_M. Umbhalo: UMT5-XXL · Q4_K_M. Ubude bevidiyo: 5 s; Aspect ratio: 21:9; Iifreyimu ngesekhondi: 16. Iividiyo ezinde zidityaniswa ngeekliphu ezimfutshane. Iindawo zokudibanisa zinokubonakala kwaye ukwenziwa kungathatha ixesha elide. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Ikuqala ukudlula kunye nokulungiselela iimodeli ezicelwe: Nemotron nge-text, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 ngekufumana ngolwimi olubanzi (CPU ngokutsha), FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Umfanekiso) kunye neengxenye zayo, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step nge-music, kunye ne-Wan2.1 ngevideo. Bheka iimeji zifileyo, indawo yomzimba, kunye nezingxelo zokuvideo apho phantsi. Ukudlula kunye nokubuka kuhlala kusebenza.
creation.videoDurationNote: Iividiyo ezinde zidityaniswa ngeekliphu ezimfutshane. Iindawo zokudibanisa zinokubonakala kwaye ukwenziwa kungathatha ixesha elide.
creation.configure: Khetha imodeli yelifu kunye neqhosha layo le-API, okanye uqwalasele injini ekhethiweyo yendawo kunye neefayile zayo ezifunekayo kwiisetingi zokuDala.
creation.localNote: Imifanekiso yasekuhlaleni isebenzisa ifolda ye-Diffusers epheleleyo, yahlula i-GGUF/Safetensors amacandelo ane-stable-diffusion.cpp, okanye i-NVFP4 CUDA yendalo exhaswayo ubunzima ngePython 3.15.1. Ividiyo isebenzisa iiDiffusers. CPU/GPU ukhetho lwahlukileyo kwi-encoder kunye nejenereyitha yomfanekiso kwiinjini ezisekelwe kumacandelo.
creation.autosave: Imifanekiso egqityiweyo kunye neevidiyo zigcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwiifolda ezahlukeneyo Novera ngaphakathi kwesixokelelwano sakho Imifanekiso kunye neefolda zeVidiyo, kunye noseto lwesizukulwana.
creation.autoNote: ngokuzenzekelayo ibona umfanekiso ocacileyo okanye izicelo zokwenziwa kwevidiyo ngesiFrentshi nesiNgesi. Ungasoloko ukhetha ifomati yemveliso ngokwakho.
creation.source: Indalo ekhoyo iya kusetyenziswa njengomfanekiso wokufaka.
creation.variantPrompt: Yenza inguqulelo entsha yalo mfanekiso, ugcine umxholo wawo ophambili.
creation.missing: Le mveliso isusiwe okanye ayisafumaneki kule khompyutha.
creation.desktopOnly: Ukwenza umfanekiso kunye nevidiyo ngokugcina ngokuzenzekelayo kuyafumaneka kwisicelo sedesktop.
creation.inputUnsupported: Sebenzisa umfanekiso omnye oxhaswa yimodeli ekhethiweyo. Ungeniso lwevidiyo kunye nemifanekiso emininzi yokufaka ayixhaswa apha.
creation.animatePrompt: Dlala lo mfanekiso ngelixa ugcina umxholo wawo ophambili.
creation.filterNote: Umfanekiso kunye neVidiyo yokucoca imveliso eyenziweyo. Iimodeli ze-Multimodal zinokuqonda iindidi ezininzi zokufaka; oku akuthethi ukuba banokuvelisa imifanekiso okanye ividiyo.
creation.generationOnly: Le modeli yenza imidiya. Yikhethe kudidi loMfanekiso okanye lweVidiyo.
creation.cloudNote: Isizukulwana samafu sithumela umfanekiso wakho okhawulezileyo kunye negalelo kumboneleli okhethiweyo kwaye sinokufumana iindleko. Ukumisa ekuhlaleni akunako ukurhoxisa amatyala akude.
creation.cloudDefaults: Ifu isebenzisa iiseti ezikhethekileyo zomboneleli. Iiparamitha zasekuhlaleni zisebenza kwinjini yokudala ekhethiweyo yasekuhlaleni.
creation.cloudTimeout: Umsebenzi welifu awuzange ugqibe phakathi kwexesha elimiselweyo. Jonga imeko yayo kunye nomboneleli phambi kokuba uqale esinye isizukulwana esihlawulwayo.
creation.adobeCredentials: I-Adobe Firefly idinga ithokheni yofikelelo kunye ne-x-api-key isichongi somthengi kwiisethingi zomboneleli.
creation.catalogNote: Lo mboneleli usebenzisa uluhlu olugciniweyo lwemodeli. Ukuyihlaziya akuqinisekisi isitshixo okanye ukufikelela kwiakhawunti yakho. Akukho sizukulwana sihlawulelwayo sisetyenziselwa ukuvavanya iziqinisekiso.
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Isifaki khowudi sombhalo (GGUF okanye iziKhuseli ezihambelanayo)
creation.ggufNote: Khetha imodeli yokusasazwa, ikhowudi yokubhaliweyo kunye ne-VAE ngokwahlukeneyo. Kwi-FLUX.2 Klein 4B, sebenzisa i-encoder ye-Qwen3-4B ehambelanayo, kuquka neentlobo zayo ze-GGUF. Iifayile ze-NVFP4 ezixhaswayo zilungiselelwe kanye ngePython 3.15.1 kunye nePyTorch kwi-cache enkulu yokuhambelana; imvelaphi ihlala ingatshintshi. Oku kufuna indawo yedisk eyongezelelweyo kunye ne-RAM. Kwi-Windows, i-Novera ibandakanya kwaye ilawula injini ngokuzenzekelayo. Isebenzisa izixhobo ezikhoyo; I-CUDA ifuna ukwakhiwa kwe-CUDA. I-Distilled Klein iqhele ukusebenzisa amanyathelo ama-4 kunye ne-CFG 1. Akukho bunzima obukhutshelwayo.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Le GGUF iqulethe ikhowudi yombhalo. Yikhethe kwibala leekhowudi kwaye ukhethe imodeli yosasazo eyahlukileyo kumhlaba womfanekiso.
creation.nativeNote: I-NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B iintsimbi ezi-Comfy, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder kunye ne-FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Ifuna iBlackwell (i-RTX 50 series okanye ehambelanayo), i-Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch kunye nokuxhomekeka kwe-NVFP4 okukhethiweyo. Umbhalo ukuya kumfanekiso kuphela. Iihardware ezingaxhaswanga ziyasilela ngokucacileyo; khetha i-stable-diffusion.cpp yokuhambelana. Akukho BF16 i-cache yokusasazwa.
creation.deviceNote: La malungu anokhetho oluzimeleyo lwesixhobo. Isebenzisa izixhobo ezikhoyo; I-NVFP4 yomthonyama isoloko ifuna i-GPU ehambelanayo yokuvelisa kwaye isebenzisa i-GPU i-encoding yombhalo xa ngokwaneleyo i-VRAM isimahla. I-Qwen kwi-CPU inokugcina i-VRAM kodwa i-encoding ecothayo. I-Qwen kwi-GPU isebenzisa umaleko wokukhuphela. Kwi-stable-diffusion.cpp, i-Auto ilandela injini ekhethiweyo; ukunyanzelisa i-CUDA kufuna i-CUDA yokwakha.
creation.totalTimeHint: Lilonke ixesha libandakanya ukulayisha, ukufakwa kwekhowudi yombhalo, ukuvelisa, naliphi na ilifu elilindileyo, ukukhuphela kunye nokugcina. Isizukulwana sisodwa siboniswa ngokwahlukeneyo xa injini ibika.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU isizukulwana, Qwen3-4B encoding on CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Ivavanywe kwiWindows ngeVulkan; isantya kunye nokuhambelana kuxhomekeke kwi-hardware yakho.
creation.seedNote: Imifanekiso yasekuhlaleni kuphela. Thelekisa imodeli efanayo kunye nezicwangciso.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Esona sisombululo siphezulu kwi-Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Imemori eyaneleyo iyafuneka.
creation.upscaleNote: Emva kwesizukulwana. Ifuna iPython/PyTorch. Ubuninzi bemveliso: × 2 4096 × 4096, × 4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Faka iimodeli okanye ukhethe ifayile ehambelanayo .pth, uze ujonge iPython/PyTorch.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Ukutshintsha umlinganiselo kulungelelanisa isisombululo sangoku. Imilinganiselo isebenzisa uphinda-phindo lwe-16, ukuya kuthi ga kwi-2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Ngokuzikhethelayo NVFP4 ubunzima bento ebhaqiweyo NVIDIA Blackwell GPU okanye entsha ubuncinane nge-4.5 GiB ye VRAM. Ukusebenzisa obu bunzima kwi-Novera, indawo yokugcina imodeli epheleleyo kufuneka iqale iguqulwe ibe yi NVFP4 ehambelanayo GGUF kwaye iqinisekisiwe. Olu guqulelo alukaqinisekiswa kule ndawo yokukhangela. Ifayile edityanisiweyo ye Safetensors ayinakulayishwa ngokuthe ngqo yinjini eyakhelweyo. Q8_0 ihlala isincomo esilungele ukusetyenziswa. Iimfuno zememori zikwaxhomekeke kubude bomxholo.

creationInstall.confirm: Khuphela ezi fayile kule folda? Iilayisensi zababoneleli ziyasebenza.
creationInstall.background: Ungaqhubeka uncokola kwaye wenze imifanekiso okanye iividiyo ngexesha lokukhuphela. Landela inkqubela usebenzisa i icon yebar engundoqo.
creationInstall.engine: Injini eyakhelwe-ngaphakathi: ngokuzenzekelayo CUDA / Vulkan / CPU
creationInstall.note: GPU isizukulwana, Qwen3-4B encoding on CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Ivavanywe kwiWindows ngeVulkan; isantya kunye nokuhambelana kuxhomekeke kwi-hardware yakho.
creationInstall.error: Ufakelo aluphumelelanga. Jonga inethiwekhi yakho, indawo yasimahla, amalungelo okufikelela kunye neelayisenisi zemodeli, emva koko uqalise kwakhona.

memory.title: imodeli yenkumbulo yendawo
memory.autoNote: Ilayisha iimodeli ngokwemfuno kwaye ikhuphe iimodeli ezingasetyenziswanga emva kokugqitywa komsebenzi osebenzayo.
memory.manualNote: Umbhalo, umfanekiso kunye nevidiyo zinokuqhutywa kunye kwiincoko ezahlukeneyo ukuba RAM/VRAM ziyavuma. Iimodeli zinokuphelelwa yinkumbulo.
memory.preserve: Iifayile kunye neencoko ziyagcinwa; iimodeli ziphinda zilayishe xa kufuneka. Utshintsho luyasebenza kwizicelo ezitsha.
memory.failed: Ugcino lwenkumbulo akuphumelelanga. Phinda uzame okanye ukhethe iManuwali.

sharing.imageHint: Ukuguqulwa kwemifanekiso kusebenzisa isakhelo sokumisa. I-SVG ifakela umfanekiso we-raster; I-ICO ilinganiselwe kwi-256 px.
sharing.videoHint: Sebenzisa i-HTML okanye i-ZIP ukugcina ukudlalwa kwevidiyo kunye neefayile zokuqala.
sharing.fallback: Ukwabelana ngenkqubo akufumaneki apha kule fomati. Gcina okanye uprinte ifayile.
sharing.tooLarge: Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kukhulu kakhulu. Khetha izinto ezimbalwa okanye wabelane ngemidiya yokuqala.
sharing.failed: Ayikwazi ukugqiba ukuthumela ngaphandle okanye ukwabelana. Jonga iifayile kwaye uzame enye ifomathi.
sharing.localHint: Hlaziya umxholo okhethiweyo ngaphambi kokwabelana. Akukho linki yoluntu yenziweyo.
sharing.linuxHint: Linux ivula isicelo sakho se-imeyile ngokuncamathisela. Akukho nto ithunyelwa ngokuzenzekelayo.

instructions.textDefault: Ungu-Novera. Phendula ngokucacileyo, ngokuchanekileyo nangokufutshane ngolwimi lomsebenzisi. Landela imiqobo yabo, qinisekisa iinyani eziphambili xa kunokwenzeka kwaye uchaze ukungaqiniseki. Ungaze uyile imithombo, iziphumo okanye izenzo ezigqityiweyo.
instructions.imageDefault: Landela isihloko esiceliweyo, isimbo kunye nokuqulunqa. Sebenzisa ukubunjwa okucacileyo, ukukhanya okuhambelanayo kunye neenkcukacha ezintle. Gcina izazisi zereferensi; kuphephe ukugqwetheka kunye nezinto ezingafunekiyo. Yongeza umbhalo kuphela xa uceliwe.
instructions.videoDefault: Landela isihloko esiceliweyo, isimbo kunye nobude bexesha. Gcina imixholo, izinto kunye nezibane zingaguquguquki kuzo zonke izakhelo. Sebenzisa intshukumo egudileyo kunye nomsebenzi wekhamera elawulwayo. Kuphephe ukuqhwanyaza, ukugqwetheka kunye nombhalo ongacelwanga.
